data.title: Fill three gaps in the lane table
data.question: (1) Only a session or integrator may write DecisionRaised, yet §5 says the loop "raises a tier-2 decision" for a conflict, and project decisions (raised_by.task null) have no lane. (2) "Its own task" can only be known from TaskSessionAttached, which only the loop writes, so in the manual phase every session handoff fails the lane. (3) RouteResolved is orchestrator-only, so a route to the lead or a session closes only when its question is answered.

options.tradeoff: Let the loop, orchestrator and lead raise decisions (task null allowed). Add an optional `session` to TaskDrafted, or accept the orchestrator's attach. Let any route's owner resolve it.
Keep the table as written. Implemented. Lane conflicts will be reported for these cases.

context.summary: The code follows the table literally (core.Lanes, CheckLaneIn). Once the CLI and loop write events, all three cases will show up as lane conflicts.
